title: Unramified localization of the corrected-coordinate map
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, n,c natural numbers, P=R[x_1,...,x_n], f_j in P, J=(f_j), C=P/J and D=C[y_1,...,y_c] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Suppose a_ij in C satisfy sum_i (partial_i f_j mod J) a_ik = delta_jk. Define the R-algebra map theta:P -> D by x_i |-> (x_i mod J) - sum_j a_ij y_j. There is g in D with constant coefficient 1 such that the composite P -> D -> D_g [def-weil-ring-localization-away] is formally unramified, meaning its relative differential module is zero [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials].

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07CH, corrected coordinates, Nakayama localization and fibrewise flatness; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CH

proof.text: The relative differential module M of D over P through theta is finite: the finitely many original x_i and y_j generate D as a P-algebra. It is generated by dx_i and dy_j. Differentiating an original polynomial h gives sum_i (partial_i h mod J) dx_i by the polynomial differential basis.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07CH, corrected coordinates, Nakayama localization and fibrewise flatness; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CH

proof.text: Let I_y be the ideal generated by the y_j. Since dz_i=0, dx_i is sum_j a_ij dy_j modulo I_y M. Differentiating f_j=0 and using the assumed right inverse gives dy_j=0 modulo I_y M. Hence also dx_i=0 and M=I_y M. These are identities of derivations and finite sums, including empty index sets.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07CH, corrected coordinates, Nakayama localization and fibrewise flatness; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CH

proof.text: Nakayama applied to the finite module M gives g-1 in I_y annihilating M. The constant-coefficient homomorphism kills I_y, so constantCoeff g=1. Localization of differentials makes M_g the differentials of D_g over P; multiplication by g is both zero and invertible there, hence M_g=0. Mathlib formallyUnramified_iff identifies this with formal unramifiedness.

lean.statement: theorem exists_unramified_conormal_polynomial_chart (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (a : Fin n → Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)) (ha : ∀ j k, ∑ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) (MvPolynomial.pderiv i (f j)) * a i k = if j = k then 1 else 0) : let C := MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f) let D := MvPolynomial (Fin c) C let θ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R →ₐ[R] D := MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ MvPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) (MvPolynomial.X i)) - ∑ j, MvPolynomial.C (a i j) * MvPolynomial.X j) ∃ g : D, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff g = 1 ∧ @FormallyUnramified (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.Away g) _ _ (((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R D (Localization.Away g)).comp θ).toRingHom.toAlgebra)
